info.title: WDC Store — Repository API
info.description:
CRUD and query endpoints for the WDC Store data model.

**Authentication**: write operations require a Bearer JWT.
Obtain tokens via `POST /api/auth/login` after requesting a
challenge nonce from `GET /api/auth/challenge`.

**Projection**: fetch operations accept an optional `projection`
field containing a partial entity — only the specified fields are
returned in the response.

**Criteria**: each filterable field is sent as a `Criterion` object
carrying one or more comparison requests — see the `Criterion`
schema. Requests on the same field combine with `AND` unless the
field sets `"or": true`; different fields always combine with `AND`.

**Projected collections**: a one-to-many field in a *projection*
is an object (`ProjectedCollection`) declaring the item shape plus
the criteria, ordering and slice to apply to the collection. In a
*response* the same field is the plain array of rows.

retryAfter.description: On a 429: the seconds to wait before trying again, as in the Retry-After header

count.description: Number of affected or matching rows

CountResult.description: Result of a delete or count operation

v.description: Values for the operator — one for EQ/NE/GT/GE/LT/LE/LIKE/ILIKE, two for BETWEEN, many for IN, omitted for IS_NULL/IS_NOT_NULL. LIKE and ILIKE take the wildcards as part of the value, as in SQL.

CriterionPredicate.description: A single comparison request within a criterion.

or.description: Combine this field's requests with OR instead of AND. Defaults to false.

p.description: The comparison requests, in the order they were made

Criterion.description:
A filterable field. Every criteria field of every entity uses this shape — pass it alongside the pagination parameters, keyed by the field name (`productId`, `userName`, …).

Requests accumulate: `{"p":[{"o":"GE","v":[10]},{"o":"LE","v":[20]}]}` means a range. They combine with `AND` unless `or` is true. A bare value is also accepted and read as equality.

shape.description: One partial item declaring which fields of each row to return

where.description: Criteria for the child entity — same shape as a top-level criteria object, with `Criterion` fields plus an optional `orderBy`.

limit.description: Maximum child rows to return. Order the collection too, or the cut is arbitrary.

offset.description: Child rows to skip. Order the collection too, or the skip is arbitrary.

ProjectedCollection.description:
A one-to-many field inside a projection. Declares the shape of one item plus the criteria, ordering and slice to apply to the collection.

In a **response** the same field is the plain array of rows instead — the two are told apart by their JSON type.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return — 0 means unlimited

projection.description: Partial entity declaring which fields to include in the response

FetchRequest.description: Common query parameters. Each entity's criteria fields and `orderBy` are in its own schema — `ProductCriteria`, `UserCriteria`, `PurchaseCriteria`, `PurchaseItemCriteria` — and the accepted body is the union of both.

projection.description: Partial entity declaring which fields to include in the response

PageRequest.description: Common parameters of a paginated query. Each entity's criteria fields and `orderBy` are in its own schema, and the accepted body is the union of both.

FetchByIdRequest.description: Fetch a single entity by ID, optionally narrowing the returned fields with a projection.

nonce.description: Single-use nonce, good for this user only

ChallengeResponse.description: SCRAM-SHA-256 challenge. An unknown user gets made-up parameters, the same every time.

nonce.description: Nonce from POST /api/auth/challenge for this userName

LoginRequest.description: SCRAM-SHA-256 sign-in. SaltedPassword = PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256(digest, salt, iterations), where digest is MD5(password) as a signed integer in base 36; ClientKey = HMAC(SaltedPassword, "Client Key"); proof = ClientKey XOR HMAC(SHA-256(ClientKey), "n=<userName>,r=<nonce>").

publicKey.description: The session's RSA public key (Base64 SPKI): encrypts a password sent to the user API

serverSignature.description: Sign-in only: HMAC(HMAC(SaltedPassword, "Server Key"), "n=<userName>,r=<nonce>") (Base64); the client checks it to know the server holds the verifier

TokenResponse.description: Issued or refreshed JWT token pair

Product.description: Product. All fields are optional when used as a projection.

User.description: User. The password field is never included in responses.

items.description: Line items. In a **response**, the array of rows. In a **projection**, a `ProjectedCollection` object declaring the item shape plus the criteria, ordering and slice to apply.

Purchase.description: Purchase. All fields are optional when used as a projection.

PurchaseItem.description: Purchase line item. All fields are optional when used as a projection.
